note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸列，模板沒有；金額不為零時才顯示，並標「模板無此列」。
note.en: An extension row added by the site. The template has no such line; it is shown only when the amount is not nil, marked as absent from the template.

definition.zh-TW:
向銀行等債權人借入長期借款時收到的現金。

這是籌資活動的流入，公司的現金與非流動負債同時增加。
definition.en:
Cash received when the company takes out a long-term loan.

It is a financing inflow: cash and non-current liabilities rise together.

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表籌資活動區；這是網站補充的延伸列，課程模板沒有，也不列入期中考範圍；金額不為 0 時才顯示並標「模板無此列」。本課故事只有短期借款，所以用不到。
example.en: Where it sits: the financing activities section of the statement of cash flows; it is an extension line added by the site, absent from the course template and outside the midterm scope, shown only when the amount is non-zero and marked as not in the template. The course story has only short-term borrowing, so it is not used.

misconception.zh-TW: 把借到的錢當成收入。借款要還，所以是負債；它讓現金變多，但本期淨利一毛錢都不會增加。
misconception.en: Treating loan proceeds as income. The money must be repaid, so it is a liability; it increases cash but adds nothing to profit for the period.
